Wonderful read, thank you. I've been struggling with the "meaning of life," my spirituality, and mortality for as long as I can remember. Oddly enough while I was in the USAF I had no fear of flying, but after we lost an engine in my last training deployment I haven't been able to fly. In addition to this I've always been a fairly stoic individual, but I guess I never realized the depth of meaning that term carries.

This article put it in to perspective why I shouldn't have this fear of flying, as hard as it is to control subconscious feelings, this really did help. Oddly enough at my lowest, I held what I would call nihilistic beliefs, and even then, thinking or knowing nothing in our current mortal realm matters universally, I was still afraid of flying. Even today, imagining the angle of ascent on take off was causing me anxiety, but after reading this I do truly feel a certain sense of calm. Going to try to focus on that feeling and develop it to the point where I truly do feel comfortable again in any day to day sitatuion, to include flying. Thank you for sharing.
